title: Signed summand and naturality laws for the native ringed total comparison
statement: For a normalized underived bifunctor comparison and the associated total map, the total map satisfies the signed homogeneous summand equation and naturality in both complex variables.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YN, 06YU and 0FPT

proof.text: Rewrite the chosen chain hom by hchain and take its degree-n component. Reassociate and apply HomologicalComplex.map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX to its first factor. The signed summand formula HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorFlipIso_hom then computes its second factor. Replace the comparison component by U.underived using hτ, and replace sign by its prescribed integer scalar using hsign. For the cochain shape the flip scalar is (q*p).negOnePow; commutativity of integer multiplication and bilinearity of composition give exactly the asserted signed inclusion.

First identify the map of the uncurried total bifunctor with the simultaneous mapBifunctorMap: test degree n on each coproduct inclusion, use ι_mapBifunctorMap twice for the two successive maps, and simplify identity maps. This gives the simultaneous component formula. Apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison_naturality to the total comparison and HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorFlipIso_hom_naturality to the flip, with the two image maps in reversed order. Regard these equations as commutative squares. Their vertical composite via Mathlib CommSq.vert_comp is naturality of the composite total map. Rewrite both chosen chain homs by hchain, and use the proved identification of maps to obtain the coefficientTotalTensor map. No underived existence theorem or further tensor comparison is used.
